position_method: Manual visual estimates on actual unchanged source wall edge chains. Ranges express transcription uncertainty, not a measured 0.5 m accuracy certificate. Pixel centers retained for checking. Null station means plan position still UNKNOWN.
row_convention: G and U labels name visible photo bands, not surveyed absolute levels. R0 on B042 is the lowest exposed river band. Compound glazed band/group is one observed wall-opening group; pane count is not invented.
